CustomField.description: Picklist Match only. Optional rules used when the PDF label has no value, one per line: a regular expression matched against the PDF text, then =>, then the value. Example: (?im)^document number:\s*SOP => SOP
CustomField.inlineHelpText: One rule per line: regular expression => value. The first rule that matches the PDF text sets the value.
CustomField.label: Match Rules
